title: Liquid integrator params
description: Controls how POIs from all active liquid modes are merged into a single LiquidMeasurementResult.

cluster_window_px.description: POIs within this many pixels of each other are merged into the same cluster.

quorum_threshold.description: Minimum cluster score (sum of member weights) to produce a confident result. Increase to require stronger multi-mode agreement.

spread_flag_threshold.description: If the top-2 cluster scores are within this fractional ratio of each other, the result is flagged as low_confidence. Lower = stricter.
